purpose: Teach: よせ/想う/絶好調/道端/窮屈/ハメ/等しく/踏み出し

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.en: Riku, cut it out with the trash talk.
lines.style: Sharp but not unkind. Quick attack on the opening. Familiar cadence—the ease of friends who've said this before. Light warning, not lecture.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、好きな子を想う気持ちで勉強しろよ、桜
lines.en: You should study thinking about that girl you like, Sakura.
lines.style: Dry smirk in the tone. Knowing. Lean into the teasing without meanness. Slight lift at the end—watching for her reaction. Cool-distant surface, warm beneath.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、最近絶好調だな
lines.en: Riku, you've been on fire lately.
lines.style: Genuine warmth breaking through. Straightforward, no sarcasm here. Eyes forward. The kind of compliment that costs her to say and she doesn't soften it.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、道端でカエル拾うなよ、桜
lines.en: You shouldn't just pick up frogs off the street, Sakura.
lines.style: Wry, almost amused. Light touch—not scolding, observing the absurdity. The patience of someone used to her strange habits. Slight shake of the head in the voice.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、その制服きつくて窮屈そうだぞ
lines.en: Riku, that uniform looks really tight on you these days.
lines.style: Quiet observation, not judgment. Softer than her usual tone. Noticing something real. Small concern tucked under the surface. Speaking half to herself.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、テストで赤点取るハメになるな、桜
lines.en: You're going to end up flunking your tests if you keep this up, Sakura.
lines.style: Direct warning with an undertone of worry. Matter-of-fact delivery. The kind of thing he wouldn't say if he didn't care. Firm but not harsh.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、ノートを等しく仲間と共有しろよ
lines.en: Share your notes equally with your classmates, Riku.
lines.style: Straightforward directive. Steady tone—not angry, guiding. The friend who knows he hoards things and is gently pushing him to open up. Brief, clear intention.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、進路へ一歩踏み出したな、桜
lines.en: You've actually taken a real step forward with your future, Sakura.
lines.style: Warm recognition, almost surprised at himself for saying it. Soft attack. Genuine without being sappy. The praise that lands because it's rare from him and he means every word.
